context: Sakura tells Ren she's been offered her first book deal.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: レン兄ちゃん、本、出せる事、なった。
lines.en: Ren—my book is actually getting published.
lines.style: Quiet joy breaking through. Soft attack on the name. Warm, almost disbelieving on the main news. Eyes brighter than her voice. Paced like she's still letting it sink in.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: え、本当！おめでとう、本当！
lines.style: Sharp intake of breath at the start. Real excitement, not performed. Lands hard on both congratulations—one spontaneous, one deliberate. Leans forward slightly with genuine warmth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Soft wonder underneath. Slow pace—savoring the words. Slight breathiness, like she's still catching up to the reality. Trailing off gently, almost to herself.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: All that effort shows. People will see it.
lines.style: Warm assertion. Steady conviction in the middle. Not flattering—observing clearly. The tone of someone who watched her work. Grounded, firm but tender.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: I'm so grateful for everyone's support through this.
lines.style: Quiet and genuine. Slight tremor underneath, emotion kept close. Eyes probably glistening. Pace unhurried. Lands on gratitude like it matters enormously.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 一緒に、ここまで、来たね。
lines.en: We got here together, didn't we.
lines.style: Soft reflection. Warm eye contact. Not a question despite the shape. Slight smile in the voice. Pace that lets each word sit. Small pause at the end, acknowledging the weight of it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お父さん、お母さん、絶対、喜ぶ。
lines.en: Your parents—they're going to be so happy.
lines.style: Anticipatory warmth. Slight laugh underneath. Voice brightens thinking about their reaction. Genuine pleasure in imagining it. No doubt at all.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: We should celebrate together—all of us.
lines.style: Warm proposal. Gentle but clear. Opening with thoughtfulness. Ends on slight uplift, hopeful and inviting. The tone of including people who matter.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Quick agreement with genuine enthusiasm. Soft planning energy. Voice has that small-smile quality. Pace picks up slightly on the idea. Genuine warmth about bringing people together.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 頑張ってきた、お前、誇り。
lines.en: I'm proud of you for everything you've put into this.
lines.style: Direct and unguarded. Deeper voice, older-brother sincerity. Lands on the word proud with quiet weight. No distance. Slight pause before, gathering the feeling. Eye contact steady.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: I'm grateful to everyone in this family.
lines.style: Soft and whole. Each word given equal weight. Gentle, not rushed. Slight tremor of real feeling. Eyes down briefly, then up. The tone of genuine thanks.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Quiet and reflective. Slow pace throughout. Thoughtful distance on the opening word. Deeper register. Lands soft on precious like it's an entire sentence. Trailing stillness.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: これからも、書き続ける。
lines.en: I'll keep writing from here on.
lines.style: Quiet commitment. Soft but unshakeable. Eyes forward. Voice steady like a promise to herself as much as to him. Slow close. Slight pause at the end—settling into the weight of it.
